critique: Three passes of three: the character is the screen's subject, framed large and readable in the toon look.

Three fails of three: the subtitle 'Skyskipper · Carrier' and the 'Level 3 of 10' label sit straight on the starfield gradient with no ink outline; the pass anchor outlines every word over art. Narrow point: give every word over art the kit's ink outline.

Four fails of six (p f f f f p): the open ability card is about twice Level up's area, dark, with serif prose about as large as the LEVEL UP label, and in grayscale it outweighs the mid-grey Level up bar. Narrow point: collapse the ability card to its header as the anchor does, or shrink its prose, and strengthen Level up's label and value.
Three fails of three: 'Skyskipper · Carregador' and 'Nível 3 de 10' sit on the starfield gradient with no ink outline. Narrow point: as at 100%, outline every word over art.
Three passes of three: 'Subir de nível' is the largest, lightest and most saturated block at the foot; nothing competes.
Three passes of three: gold fills the main action and the arrows, the chosen tab takes a gold rim, green is the level bar and the Essence drop, and the level bar is segmented and labelled.
Three fails of six (f p p p f f), so it passes. The failing samples saw the same heavy ability card as at 100%; the fix there will settle this one too.
